entries.label: SPARQL namespace prefixes
entries.text:
NAMESPACE PREFIXES:
  proto: <https://proto.atlas/ontology/>
  data:  <https://proto.atlas/data/>
  tax:   <https://proto.atlas/taxonomy/>
  rel:   <https://proto.atlas/relationship/>
  skos:  <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
SPARQL NOTES:
  - Taxonomy fields (tactic, category, riskLevel, owner) store URI values, NOT strings
  - To filter by tactic label use: FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?t), "TA0006"))
  - MITRE tactic URIs: TA0001=InitialAccess TA0002=Execution TA0003=Persistence
    TA0004=PrivilegeEscalation TA0005=DefenseEvasion TA0006=CredentialAccess
    TA0007=Discovery TA0008=LateralMovement TA0009=Collection
    TA0010=Exfiltration TA0011=CommandAndControl TA0040=Impact
  - To get tactic label: ?m proto:tactic ?t . ?t skos:prefLabel ?tacticLabel
  - Use OPTIONAL for non-required fields
  - Filter by class: ?x a proto:LibraryModule
  - Instances: data:{key} e.g. data:cs-start-c2

WORKING SPARQL PATTERNS (use these exact structures):
  # Filter by tactic:
  ?m proto:tactic ?t . FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?t), "TA0006"))

  # Get tactic label:
  ?m proto:tactic ?t . ?t skos:prefLabel ?tacticLabel .

  # Count modules per tactic (GROUP BY):
  SELECT ?tacticLabel (COUNT(?m) AS ?count) WHERE {
    ?m a proto:LibraryModule ; proto:tactic ?t .
    ?t skos:prefLabel ?tacticLabel .
  } GROUP BY ?tacticLabel ORDER BY DESC(?count)

  # Gap analysis - MITRE tactics with no modules:
  # Use CONTAINS(STR(?t), "mitre-TA") to match only MITRE tactic URIs
  SELECT DISTINCT ?tacticLabel WHERE {
    ?t skos:prefLabel ?tacticLabel .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?t), "mitre-TA"))
    FILTER(NOT EXISTS { ?m a proto:LibraryModule ; proto:tactic ?t . })
  }

GRAPHDB RESTRICTIONS:
  - tax:mitre-tactics scheme does NOT exist in the graph — never use skos:inScheme tax:mitre-tactics
  - To find all tactics derive them from modules: ?m proto:tactic ?t . ?t skos:prefLabel ?label
  - NEVER use: FILTER(?x NOT IN (SELECT ...)) — use FILTER(NOT EXISTS {...}) instead
  - NEVER hardcode tactic URIs like proto:TA0006 — use FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?t),"TA00XX"))
  - GROUP BY requires all SELECT vars to be either aggregated or in GROUP BY
  - Subqueries must use { SELECT ... } syntax inside the WHERE block

entries.label: Codebase
entries.text:
CLASS proto:Codebase (Codebase)
  Definition: A source repository or codebase tracked in ProtoGraph.
  Properties:
  - proto:category : reference [taxonomy: c2-frameworks]
  - proto:defaultBranch : string
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:language : string
  - proto:name : string (REQUIRED)
  - proto:owner : reference [taxonomy: teams]
  - proto:repoUrl : string
  - proto:riskLevel : reference [taxonomy: risk-levels]
  - proto:status : string

entries.label: Dependency
entries.text:
CLASS proto:Dependency (Dependency)
  Definition: An external package or library consumed by code.
  Properties:
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:name : string (REQUIRED)
  - proto:owner : reference [taxonomy: teams]
  - proto:riskLevel : reference [taxonomy: risk-levels]
  - proto:status : string

entries.label: Service
entries.text:
CLASS proto:Service (Service)
  Definition: A deployable service within a codebase.
  Properties:
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:name : string (REQUIRED)
  - proto:owner : reference [taxonomy: teams]
  - proto:riskLevel : reference [taxonomy: risk-levels]
  - proto:status : string

entries.label: Source File
entries.text:
CLASS proto:SourceFile (Source File)
  Definition: A source file or package-level unit in a repository.
  Properties:
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:kind : string
  - proto:name : string (REQUIRED)
  - proto:owner : reference [taxonomy: teams]
  - proto:path : string
  - proto:riskLevel : reference [taxonomy: risk-levels]
  - proto:status : string

entries.label: Team
entries.text:
CLASS proto:Team (Team)
  Definition: 
  Properties:
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:name : string (REQUIRED)
  - proto:owner : reference [taxonomy: teams]
  - proto:riskLevel : reference [taxonomy: risk-levels]
  - proto:status : string

entries.label: Codebase Categories
entries.text:
TAXONOMY c2-frameworks (Codebase Categories): 3 terms
  Valid values: Automation Platform, C2 Framework, Observability
  Referenced by: proto:category
  Use in FILTER: ?x proto:category ?v . ?v skos:prefLabel "Automation Platform"

entries.label: Risk Levels
entries.text:
TAXONOMY risk-levels (Risk Levels): 3 terms
  Valid values: High, Low, Medium
  Referenced by: proto:riskLevel
  Use in FILTER: ?x proto:riskLevel ?v . ?v skos:prefLabel "High"

entries.label: Teams
entries.text:
TAXONOMY teams (Teams): 2 terms
  Valid values: Platform Engineering, Security Engineering
  Referenced by: proto:owner
  Use in FILTER: ?x proto:owner ?v . ?v skos:prefLabel "Platform Engineering"

entries.label: edge relationship types
entries.text:
RELATIONSHIP TYPES (edge predicates):
  rel:LEADS_TO — sequential dependency (transitive)
  rel:MAPS_TO_TECHNIQUE — module implements a MITRE technique
  rel:SUPPORTS_TECHNIQUE — range env supports a technique
  rel:REQUIRES_TECHNIQUE — scenario requires a technique
  rel:OWNED_BY — artifact is owned by a team (inverse: rel:OWNS)
  rel:OWNS — team owns an artifact
  rel:BELONGS_TO — person belongs to a team
  rel:RELATED_TO — general semantic relationship (symmetric)
